meta.coordinates: [x, z] on the ground plane. +X = east, +Z = south, north = -Z (Godot convention). Heights are meters above local ground.
meta.season: rainy season, a clear morning after night rain
meta.setting: A family compound in southern Nigeria: bungalow with a veranda, a mango tree, red laterite earth, a patch of carpet grass, a backyard farm, a block wall topped with broken bottles.

areas.name: Backpack Hollow
areas.role: Wake-up pocket. Movement and camera tutorial.
areas.story: The flattened grass where Amodu was hiding when the soda-and-potion mist hit. His school bag lies beside it, 150 m tall.

areas.name: Blade Forest
areas.role: Densest walkable grass. First scale reveal.
areas.story: Densest walkable carpet grass. Tridax 'coat buttons' weeds tower over it; the first ant trail.

areas.name: Dewdrop Garden
areas.role: Wonder beat. Beauty shot of the level.
areas.story: The mango tree's shade keeps the night's rain on every leaf. Touch-me-not (Mimosa) fronds fold shut when anything brushes them; a lost marble; a dew-strung web.

areas.name: Capstone Shelter
areas.role: Meet Opigo and Opumie. First sign of civilization.
areas.story: An ant watch post under a soft-drink crown cap propped on three pebbles, overlooking the Bare Patch.

areas.name: Bare Patch
areas.role: Pill bug tutorial fight. Colony Gate.
areas.story: Red earth where a paint-bucket planter stood all dry season; its ring is still pressed into the laterite. The earth cracked, and the ants' front door is the biggest crack.

areas.name: Hose Run
areas.story: The hose from the overhead tank leaks at its coupling; the mist makes a permanent morning rainbow. The ants run a water station here.

areas.name: Lolly-Stick Bridge
areas.role: The only dry crossing into the south. Chapter 4 termite fight.
areas.story: Night rain filled the tyre rut the family car left on the grass. An ice-lolly stick Amodu dropped spans its narrowest point.

areas.name: Mango Rootlands
areas.story: Beyond the Great Root: fallen mangoes like boulders, mango leaves as long as streets that crunch and give you away.

areas.name: Spider's Edge
areas.story: The damp corner where the mango root dives under the garden kerb. A silk-lined burrow, trip lines across the only entrance.

boundaries.note: 8 cm concrete step up to the veranda. The bungalow rises beyond it.
Concrete kerb of the interlocking-paver driveway; the family car is parked on it.
Cement blocks laid on edge around the backyard farm. Maize towers behind them.
The mango tree's trunk base and drifts of fallen mango leaves.

barriers.note: Uncut tussock between the Great Root and the puddle. Impassable.
Closes the gap between the puddle and the stepping stones.

water.name: The Rut
water.note: Mower wheel rut flooded by hose runoff. Falling in is defeat (surface tension). Neck at x=140 is 32 m wide; the 41 m stick overlaps each bank by 4.5 m.

paths.label: Chapter 1 route: wake to Colony Gate
Garden Patrol: Patrol Gate to Spider's Edge
Root tunnel (sealed in the graybox; opened from the south side later)

landmarks.name: Amodu's backpack
landmarks.real: 42 x 30 x 15 cm, upright and slumped
landmarks.note: Tallest thing in the level. Zipper on the south face is a climb route. Player compass.

landmarks.name: Tridax seed head
landmarks.real: 20 cm, gone to seed; fluffy parachutes drift over the forest

landmarks.name: Pure-water sachet
landmarks.note: Translucent nylon tent with a puddle still inside; abandoned ant rest stop.

landmarks.name: Lost marble
landmarks.note: Refracts the clover canopy. Lore item.

landmarks.name: Mango Root Hall (quest hub)
landmarks.note: Entrance between two root buttresses at the trunk base. Sealed until after the colony.

landmarks.name: Capstone (crown cap roof)
landmarks.real: 26 mm soft-drink crown cap on three 1 cm pebbles

landmarks.name: Lookout blade
landmarks.note: Thread ladder to a lookout at 25 m.

landmarks.name: Coral bead shrine
landmarks.real: one red coral bead from a broken necklace

landmarks.name: Planter ring
landmarks.note: Circular imprint of a paint-bucket planter in the red earth.

landmarks.name: Colony Gate
landmarks.real: 4 cm hair band as arch over the crack

landmarks.name: Worm castings
landmarks.note: Mounds of worm castings; also at the 'also' positions.

landmarks.name: Patrol Gate
landmarks.note: Colony side exit under a pebble.

landmarks.name: Leaking coupling / Water Station
landmarks.note: Jet sprays up and west; mist radius ~45 m with rainbow.

landmarks.name: Ice-lolly stick
landmarks.real: 11.4 cm ice-lolly stick Amodu dropped; faded printed joke on top

landmarks.name: Termite forward camp
landmarks.note: Mud tubes. Only evidence in Ch 1, occupied in Ch 2.

landmarks.name: Fallen mango
landmarks.real: 10 cm ripe mango, split and buzzing with fruit flies

landmarks.name: Mango stone
landmarks.real: 8 cm fibrous mango seed, sucked clean

landmarks.name: Baby mango
landmarks.real: 3 cm unripe mango from fruit drop

skyline.name: Mango tree
skyline.real: 50 cm trunk, first branches at 1.8 m
skyline.note: Dense evergreen canopy from 650 m up to ~3.2 km, radius ~1.8 km: the whole level sits in its shade except the east. Weaver ants nest in its leaves; mangoes drop.

skyline.name: Bungalow
skyline.note: Painted walls, burglar-proof bars on every window, a veranda, a satellite dish. Lights go off when NEPA takes light.

skyline.name: Coal pot
skyline.note: Charcoal stove on the veranda; smoke in the evening.

skyline.name: Boys' quarters
skyline.note: Small back building; the gutter runs behind it (Zone 3).

skyline.name: Overhead water tank
skyline.note: Plastic tank on a steel stand; the hose comes from its tap.

skyline.name: Clothesline
skyline.note: Ankara wrappers and school uniforms drying high overhead.

skyline.name: Family car
skyline.note: Saloon parked on the interlock driveway; its tyres made the Rut.

skyline.name: Water drum
skyline.note: Blue 200-litre drum, overflowing after the rain.

skyline.name: Pepper plants
skyline.note: Red tatashe peppers the size of houses.

skyline.name: Termite mound
skyline.note: A real mound in the compound corner: the Termite Citadel. The refuse heap beside it smoulders; smoke column ~1.5 km.

skyline.name: Store
skyline.note: Tools, kerosene and the insecticide sprayer (the finale).

skyline.name: Compound wall
skyline.note: 2.4 m block wall, broken bottles set in the top; black gate on the east side.

garden_bed.note: Raised red-earth beds of the backyard farm: maize, cassava, pepper, ugu vines.

far_lawn.note: Grass-top level of the rest of the lawn, seen from high up.

heavables_note: Loose props Amodu can lift (<= 2.6 m) or push (<= 5.5 m); see world/props/heavable.gd.
